newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Sept trade deficit grows to $276 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Sept trade deficit grows to $276 mln.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit rose to a provisional $276 million in September from $219 million in August, but fell compared to $356 million in September 1995, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
Exports decreased 0.3 percent to a provisional $662 million in September from $664 million in August, but increased 19.5 percent compared to $554 million in September 1995.
Imports increased by 6.2 percent to $938 million in September from $883 million in August and by 3.1 percent compared to $910 million in September 1995.

The trade gap in the first three months of fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) fell to a provisional $767 million from $988 million in the year-ago period. Main exports were cotton yarn, fabrics, garments and rice. Main imports were machinery, petroleum products and fertilisers. -- Islamabad newsroom 9251-274757
